title: The Double Protocol
author: Felix Quintana
blurb: Bram Nystrom, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, has spent twenty years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
